Alexis Lafrenière scored twice in the first period, and the second goal, at 12:47, came from a chance worth just 0.019 expected goals. That sums up a game NYR won 4-1 while TBL created slightly better chances, 2.66 expected goals to 2.54, and put up 57 shot attempts to 43. In a simulation of every shot, TBL wins 53 percent of the time.
